mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm glad you're here. Imagine standing on the streets of Harlem, feeling that electric mix of hope and hardship all around you. That's where our journey begins, right alongside Claude Brown in his powerful memoir, Manchild in the Promised Land. Together, we're stepping into a world where childhood dreams are constantly tested by poverty, violence, and the weight of a system that seems stacked against you. Yet, even in the darkest corners, there's a spark—the kind of resilience that makes you wonder, “How do you hold on to hope when the odds are always shifting?” As we move through stories of temptation, quick choices, and the daily fight for dignity, you'll sense how identity, belonging, and purpose are never just given... they're earned, day by day. We'll meet families and friends who sometimes lift you up, sometimes pull you down, and see how community can be both a safety net and a challenge. Racism and closed doors are constant shadows, but so are the flashes of triumph that show just how strong the human spirit can be. This isn't just about surviving—it's about claiming your place and shaping your future, even when the world keeps saying “no.” So, if you're ready, let's explore together what it really means to come of age in the heart of a city that never stops testing you.
